summary: The 37-pair rebuild is an engaging, source-accountable condensed adventure with a coherent gated ending. One small concrete Feegle-joke action is wrong in RU and EN and must be corrected before PASS; no essential retained-chain source gap remains.

literaryAssessment.essential: Coherent river threat, choice to seek help, abduction, alliance/entry, winter and one escaped trap; the search deliberately remains open. Compression is real, not an abstract lesson sequence.
literaryAssessment.core: Adds ten distinct home/history/custom/encounter beats. Reads continuously and ends after another concrete hazard without resolving the rescue.
literaryAssessment.deep: Adds fourteen distinct later-story screens: repeated dream deceptions and rescue actions, loss/recovery, confrontation and aftermath. It is not padding or a rephrased Core.
literaryAssessment.parity: All 37 RU/EN pairs compared for identities, actions, uncertainty and ordering. The required henhouse error is shared by both languages, not caused by a later translation reversal.
literaryAssessment.spoilerSafeSurfaces: Cover, descriptions, global Sources titles/notes, method, shared final and safe-mode contents/resume inspected. No decisive ending leaked in their actual reader text.
literaryAssessment.agencyAndStatus: Tiffany directs and performs the rescue/banishment; Roland has a bounded helping role. Granny Aching remains dead with an explicitly uncertain vision; Granny Weatherwax is the arriving witch. No later-book plot or critic’s moral/medical/religious interpretation adopted.

findings.scope: All three modes; same wording in manuscript, canonical JSON and effective HTML

actual.ru: Они держат яйца и пытаются объяснить, что приняли их за камни и всего лишь грели под курицей.
actual.en: They are holding eggs and trying to explain that they mistook them for stones and were only warming them under a hen.

findings.defect: The object of warming has changed. The Feegles claim they crawled under the hen to warm themselves, then treated the supposed stones as a burden on the hen. They do not claim to be warming eggs/stones under it. This reverses the concrete excuse in the retained joke.

evidence.locator: Resource Three, PDF page 21 (one-based; index 20), dialogue after “stones”, before the command to put the eggs back; web PDF lines 338–347.

smallestFaithfulFix.ru: Replace «всего лишь грели под курицей» with «всего лишь грелись под курицей».
smallestFaithfulFix.en: Replace “were only warming them under a hen” with “were only warming themselves under a hen”.
